Slate

Definition

Slate is the visual and audible identifier used to connect scene, shot, take, camera and synchronized sound records. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align production decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Sound report
  • Timecode
